findings.current: “Well, aren’t you curt? Your answers have been awfully short since earlier.”
findings.defect: The line mistakes 말씀이 짧다 for physically short answers. Here it criticizes Taekyung for speaking informally and without the expected deference, so the current version loses the hierarchy cue.
findings.rationale: The leader is objecting to Taekyung’s consistently casual speech level, not the length of his replies.
findings.replacement: “Well now. You’ve been awfully informal with me from the start.”

findings.current: Human traffickers and bandits. It was hard to say which combination was worse.
findings.defect: There is only one combination under discussion. The source says the traffickers and bandits are impossible to rank against each other.
findings.rationale: 우열을 가릴 수 없다 compares the two kinds of criminals, not multiple combinations.
findings.replacement: Human traffickers and bandits. It was hard to say which was worse.
findings.source: 인신매매범과 산적이라. 우열을 가릴 수 없는 조합이다.

findings.current: “Oh no, oh no! This poor girl is so scared!”
findings.defect: “This poor girl” adds self-pity absent from the source and loses Wolhwa’s deliberately affected, demure self-reference 소녀.
findings.rationale: 소녀 marks a conspicuous shift into mock-innocent feminine speech, which is part of Wolhwa’s performance and the scene’s humor.
findings.replacement: “Oh no, oh no! This maiden is so scared!”

findings.current: In barely ten seconds, he had brought every unnecessary fight to an end.
findings.defect: “Barely ten seconds” alters 십여 초, which means a little over or roughly ten seconds, and the current wording drops the prospective sense of the fighting that would otherwise have followed.
findings.rationale: The source specifies approximately ten-plus seconds and jokes that Mukyung preemptively ended every further fight.
findings.replacement: In just over ten seconds, he had put an end to all the unnecessary fighting that would have followed.
findings.source: 불과 십여 초 만에 이어질 모든 불필요한 싸움을 종결지었으니까.

findings.current: Hyuk Mujin, one eye swollen blue, whispered to me,
findings.defect: The source says his eye is badly bruised; “swollen” introduces a different physical condition.
findings.rationale: 멍든 denotes bruising, while 시퍼렇게 intensifies the bruise’s dark blue coloration.
findings.replacement: Hyuk Mujin, one eye bruised deep blue, whispered to me,
findings.source: 눈 한쪽이 시퍼렇게 멍든 혁무진이 내게 속삭였다.

findings.current: The culprit who had turned a Level 25 martial artist who had once approached First Rate into a living corpse had been sneaking glances in our direction for a while.
findings.defect: “Approached First Rate” is an unnatural rank collocation and can suggest an action rather than proximity to attaining the rank.
findings.rationale: 일류에 근접했던 means the martial artist had been close to reaching First Rate.
findings.replacement: The culprit who had turned a Level 25 martial artist who had once been close to First Rate into a living corpse had been sneaking glances in our direction for a while.
findings.source: 한때 일류에 근접했던 25레벨의 무인을 산송장으로 만들어 버린 범인은 아까부터 계속 이쪽을 힐끗거리고 있다.

findings.current: “They said they’d have to ride nonstop to reach Saneum. They were even worried that they might lose their heads if they arrived late.”
findings.defect: “Ride” adds a specific means of travel not stated here; 달려야 means they must hurry or travel without stopping.
findings.rationale: Although they are mounted bandits, this sentence does not explicitly say they will make the journey on horseback.
findings.replacement: “They said they’d have to travel nonstop to reach Saneum. They were even worried that they might lose their heads if they arrived late.”
findings.source: “산음(山陰)까지 가려면 쉬지 않고 달려야 한다고. 괜히 늦었다가 목 달아나는 거 아니냐고 걱정까지 하던데요.”

findings.current: A hawk descended in front of the shrine with a sharp cry.
findings.defect: “Descended” omits the completed action of the hawk landing.
findings.rationale: 내려앉았다 explicitly states that the hawk came down and alighted.
findings.replacement: A hawk landed in front of the shrine with a sharp cry.
findings.source: 날카로운 울음소리와 함께 한 마리의 매가 사당 앞에 내려앉았다.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it misreads one hierarchy cue, loses Wolhwa’s deliberately affected register, alters a stated duration, and contains several localized semantic or action errors.
